scope: Current question-level outcomes, not a graded claims register

questions.unit: 9 repair mice, 11 developmental donors; 3 intestinal test mice
questions.current_result: Frozen 50-gene pilot failed the mature intestinal endpoint; P4 pruned.
questions.open_gate: Distinct independent branch and independently supported state identities

questions.unit: Biological units vary by experiment; cross-study measurements are not paired
questions.current_result: Direct marks and outcome descriptions exist; no replicated regulatory-to-future-fate link.
questions.open_gate: Compatible early feature and later outcome linkage

questions.unit: Split culture wells from common cell mixture; independent preparation mapping remains absent
questions.current_result: ITGB6 median -0.938 log2 CPM in 3 readable groups; AREG decrement not established; standardized rho 0.2931, p 0.185637.
questions.open_gate: Independent preparations and source/receiver engagement, protein and controlled presentation
questions.roadmap_update: P1 recovered split-well hierarchy and supplemented EGF; see P1_SCREEN_DESIGN.md

questions.current_result: No standalone test separating prior injury from aging.

questions.current_result: Co-detection and Wnt source measurements do not establish sequence.
questions.open_gate: Reporter history, current activity, washout and ordered response

questions.unit: 24 independent mice in completed Strunz test

questions.unit: Donor; shared-state support must be checked
